title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Amount of an Approved Shown-Pay Adjustment
content:
**Rule.** The shown-pay adjustment approved on a completed batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches is the amount claimed on the shopper's submitted shown-pay shortfall dispute, rounded to the cent half up; a claim below the batch type's minimum dispute amount is not adjusted and books nothing.

## Elements

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Starting figure | The amount claimed on the shopper's submitted shown-pay shortfall dispute on the batch (where more than one such dispute stands submitted, the most recently submitted one) |
| Minimum | The batch type's smallest amount handled as a pay dispute; a claimed amount below it books nothing |
| Rounding | To the cent, half up |
| No submitted dispute | Nothing is booked |

The minimum is tested on the amount claimed: a claimed amount equal to the minimum is not below it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical minimum of 1.00)

| Amount claimed on the submitted dispute | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 2.35 | 2.35 |
| 1.00 | 1.00 (equal to the minimum, so not below it) |
| 0.95 | Nothing — below the minimum |
| No submitted shown-pay shortfall dispute on the batch | Nothing |
